content_html:
Cầm Đức Hiệp (b. 2004) grew up in a small town in the mountainous region of Northern Vietnam.

His works often bend genres and experiment with narrative structures to open up dialogues about identity and freedom in a world without clear boundaries.

Moc Chau, Vietnam
